name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティア
source:
One night, Shihou Souma and his childhood friend Katsuragi Marina are walking in a park after school, when human-like monsters suddenly appear. These monsters, seeming to come from another world, start attacking and raping people, to absorb magical power from them. In this chaotic situation, Amakubo Yuri, Souma's school infirmary doctor, shows up and givs ExS-Device to Marina. Using the device Marina transforms into ExS-TIA and fights the monsters.

[Translated from [url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia/intro_story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
某天晚上，紫峰苍真与青梅竹马葛城麻里奈放学后走在公园里，突然出现了一群人形怪物。这些仿佛来自异世界的怪物开始袭击并强暴人类，从他们身上吸收魔力。在这片混乱之中，校医天久保由里出现，将ExS装置交给麻里奈。借助装置，麻里奈变身为ExS-TIA，与怪物展开战斗。

[译自[url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia/intro_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
